collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — LUCK, OMENS AND LAVASTONES (LO-01 to LO-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: The lavastone a villager has carried for most of their life has gone cold, and its glow is gone.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) has carried the same lavastone with (him/her) for most of (his/her) life. It's been warm in (his/her) pocket on every journey, every hard day, every celebration. This morning (he/she) reaches for it, and it's cold. Completely cold. The glow is gone. It's just a reddish stone now, heavy and ordinary.

text_only.reason: a celebration in the story (a feast, a moment of joy); no village celebration happens in the game

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (name1) keeps carrying it anyway. It's still (his/her) own. It's still the stone that was with (him/her) for all those years. It doesn't glow. It doesn't warm. Sometimes, when (name1) holds it, (he/she) could swear it remembers. That might just be (him/her). (He/She) doesn't mind.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (name1) takes it to a quiet spot on the hill and buries it, with a few words that (he/she) doesn't share with anyone. (He/She) feels a little lost for a few days, the way you do when something that was always there isn't. Then the feeling softens. (name1) visits the spot now and then, just to sit.
